Resolves #21016

`Neo.button.Effect` now follows the contract #20833 shipped for `Neo.button.Base`: `pressed_` defaults to `null` (a plain button, no `aria-pressed`), a Boolean renders `aria-pressed` as `String(pressed)`, and the `pressed` class is toggled only for `pressed === true`. Both come from `getVdomConfig()`, which the single VDOM effect reads, so the class and the attribute change in the same update. `Neo.tab.header.EffectButton#getVdomConfig()` deletes `aria-pressed` next to setting `aria-selected`, because ARIA does not allow `aria-pressed` on `role="tab"`.

Evidence: L2 (Node unit specs, red on base, green with the change) → L2 required (AC1-AC3 are unit specs and a suite receipt). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/button/EffectAriaPressed.spec.mjs` (plain button has no `aria-pressed`; `false`/`true`/`null` transitions keep class and attribute in sync) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/button/EffectAriaPressed.spec.mjs` (tab header `EffectButton`: `aria-selected` set, no `aria-pressed`, pressed or not) |
| AC-3 | outside-CI receipt: `playwright test` over `unit/button/` + `unit/tab/` locally (Node 20, Raspberry Pi; partial checkout): 156 passed. One failure, `unit/tab/HeaderActions.spec.mjs:384` (SortZone), fails identically on unmodified `dev` in the same checkout, so I take it as my environment, not this change. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
Red on base: on unmodified `dev` the new spec fails 2 of 3 (plain button: `pressed` is `false`, not `null`; toggle: `aria-pressed` expected `"false"`, received `undefined`). The tab-header test passes on base by design; it guards against the new attribute leaking onto tabs. With the change: 3/3.

### `@phoenixbycaselka` commented on 2026-11-16T01:16:02Z

Thanks for the careful probe, you were right: a route or url turns the root into `<a>` and `aria-pressed` came along with it.

Fixed in 32fc0a7: `getVdomConfig()` now only adds `aria-pressed` when `tag === 'button'`. The `pressed` class, link navigation and the tab's `aria-selected` are unchanged.

Two regression tests added to `EffectAriaPressed.spec.mjs`:
- a pressed toggle goes button → link (`url` set) → button (`url` cleared): the attribute is absent on the link, back to `"true"` on the button, then `"false"` after unpressing
- `{route: '#details', editRoute: false, pressed: true}` renders `<a href="#details">` without `aria-pressed`

Both failed on 6d51b57 (`Received: "true"`) and pass now. The button/ + tab/ unit suites: 158 passed here; the one failure is `HeaderActions.spec.mjs:384`, which fails identically on the base commit d5530ef on my Raspberry Pi, so it's environmental (it passed in your run).
